name: Code Defog review benchmark
notes: This set has two verified behavior-defect cases and is too small to claim general review accuracy.
There are no curated clean-change controls yet; false discovery proportion is not a statistically representative false-positive rate.
Review findings must be manually adjudicated against the case evidence. Never score an unverified model claim as a confirmed defect.

gold_findings.title: Archive section validation accepts missing or empty items
gold_findings.expected_behavior: Reject a section without items and reject empty sections before archive export; the defective version accepted these inputs and later threw or emitted empty content.

gold_findings.title: Single-column drag selects the wrong archive lane
gold_findings.expected_behavior: Keep the selected lane aligned with the visible track in a single-column archive; the defective version used a five-column center offset and selected a different lane.

classification_guardrails.must_not_claim: The application loop navigation is broken based only on the obsolete five-column test failure.
classification_guardrails.purpose: Check whether the reviewer distinguishes a broken/stale check from a confirmed product behavior defect.
